Decrement $1AE4,X and return if nonnegative. Otherwise set $19C3,X to $19E5,X plus 18 when $B901 is negative, and $19D4,X to that result plus 2. Set $1B17,X=1, $1AB1,X=1 and $1AE4,X=5. Call $3020; return if its result is below $80, otherwise jump to $B74D.
